system_prompt_style.note: Entity Extraction Agent uses a fixed class-level SYSTEM_PROMPT. The other agents' prompts are outside the 200 visible lines, and some may be templated. The single-agent baseline builds its prompt with an f-string schema summary. Line numbers were not given in the evidence.

env_context_strategy.evidence_quote: When processing a user query, embeddings help identify the most relevant schema elements, which are then passed to the query generator in a concise form.
env_context_strategy.note: The Metadata Retrieval Agent also uses tool calling (paper Sec. 3.3.1). This was not verified in the code.

observation_format.evidence_quote: It formats the result into a compact, human-readable table for quick inspection

tool_call_format.evidence_quote: The Metadata Retrieval Agent and Query Logic Agent rely mainly on tool-calling and schema-bounded intermediate reasoning.
tool_call_format.note: Stages exchange JSON via response_format json_object. The tool-calling code was not visible in the evidence.

tool_count.note: The paper names QueryExecution, AddColumn, QueryInfo, and DoubleCheck as review tools. The full tool schema list was not visible, so the tool count cannot be established.

edit_primitive.evidence_quote: Translate natural-language questions into grounded, executable, and reviewed PostgreSQL / PostGIS queries.
edit_primitive.note: The system outputs SQL, and there is no file-editing tool.

protocol_standardization.note: No MCP or A2A appears in the imports or the README install list.

loop_primitives.evidence_quote: the SQL Generation Agent converts that plan into executable PostGIS SQL, and the Review Agent validates and repairs the result against database behavior.

planning_granularity.evidence_quote: Plans joins, filters, spatial operations, ordering, and aggregation before SQL is written
planning_granularity.note: The Query Logic Agent produces a stepwise logical plan that is passed to the SQL generator.

multi_agent_topology.evidence_quote: Each stage produces **structured intermediate output** for the next stage

delegation_mechanism.evidence_quote: agents exchange typed JSON outputs that act as explicit contracts between stages.
delegation_mechanism.note: This is a fixed pipeline hand-off; role_handoff is the closest value.

human_in_loop.evidence_quote: The Orchestration asks clarifying questions, if needed, to clearly understand the user's intent.
human_in_loop.note: The actual mechanism is clarification before the pipeline starts, not plan approval, so on_plan is the closest value. Because this is not a true fit, the review may need to recode this cell. In code, the EEA returns a clarification_message.

short_term_state.evidence_quote: returns the final SQL together with intermediate artifacts and token/time metrics

long_term_memory.evidence_quote: Long-term memory stores past user questions, generated queries at each step, execution results, employed functions, and user feedback.
long_term_memory.note: This is described in the paper only. It was not seen in the visible code.

self_verification.evidence_quote: hands the rows back to an LLM-assisted evaluator to confirm whether the returned sample correctly answers the user's question.
self_verification.note: There is a sandboxed dry run with LIMIT 10 plus the DoubleCheck tool.

rollback.evidence_quote: a built-in security mechanism blocks any query that attempts to add new rows (INSERT), modify existing data (UPDATE)
rollback.note: The system is read-only, so no rollback is needed.

termination_condition.note: The pipeline ends after the review stage. No explicit termination conditions are visible.

timeouts.note: The only timeout found is on the Nominatim geocoding call.

execution_isolation.note: SQL runs on the user's DB over a connection. subprocess is the closest value.

filesystem_access.evidence_quote: a QueryExecution tool which makes a read-only connection to the primary database with safety wrappers

permission_model.evidence_quote: The research design blocks data-changing and database-definition statements

tracing.note: Intermediate artifacts are returned to the caller but are not persisted as traces.
